one_liner: A brave seed-spirit carrying one bright sprout.
A quiet moon bean with a soft crescent crest.
A lucky tofu pouch with a swaying tail.
A small flame spirit with a steady warm heart.
A rain-drop spirit with a cool, unimpressed face.
Looks mild; its little ember says otherwise.
It tips toward every wish, then rights itself.
One toasted flap becomes a daring little cape.
Three bold spots mark its mischievous shell.
A sealed jar spirit that ferments its courage.
A ribbed husk opens to guide lost night walkers.
Its hanging pods sway from a living vine crown.
It changes its colors before it changes its mind.
A steady lacquer guardian with one brave eye.
One hinged paw invites good fortune inside.
A sweet-spiced mask hides a little fire.
A paper fuse flickers, but never quite bursts.
Its toasted panels open like a festival fan.
A straw tie keeps this sleepy spirit snug.
Its bright belly lights the path between shrines.
It naps in warmth and curls its flame-tail.
A charm beetle with luck on both sides.
A thick crest protects its tiny simmering flame.
Cool lime air rises from a warm little spirit.
A small iron-pan spirit keeps its arms in order.
Its red joints click softly instead of shouting.
A seed-star trail follows its long comet tail.
A calm firebird rises with a crown of flame-feathers.
